value.answer: The new GitHub Copilot experience in Slack is part of Slack Code, a collaborative coding tool that allows teams to work with AI agents directly within Slack. This feature enables users to tag coding agents like GitHub Copilot to build and ship fixes without needing to switch between different tools or conversations.
